name: Nothing But The Truth
label: Quest
description: Nothing But The Truth: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Everything is proceeding according to plan, friend. I want you to give this truth serum to Deathstalker Zraedus and he'll show you how to administer it.... Properly.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you have proven yourself of use to our dear friend, Apothecary Faustin.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew old Faustin would come up with something good! You were a tremendous help, no doubt.
Now let's get down to business, shall we?
